conviction_note: The H1 shortfall against the company's own plan can already be read off the public 月次 and the Q1 progress rate. What the release can add leans mildly positive: September already-open-store sales +5.2%, two direct peers (World, Sanyo Shokai) held their full-year plans at their own H1 prints this week and both rose the next session, the company has never revised its full-year plan mid-year in the last cycle, and the stock is down about 9% since early August while TOPIX rose. Against that sit a crowded margin long (信用倍率 12.2), consensus above the company plan, and this name selling a clean Q1 (-2.3%). So p_up is 55 on a 2.5% scale (+0.25), which is smaller than the +0.7 findings sum because the positives are read-through and inference rather than a company number.
bar: Company H1 (3-8月) plan: revenue 117,500m, OP 6,400m, ordinary 6,200m, net 5,600m (unchanged at Q1, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590286.pdf). Full-year plan ordinary 12,300m against IFIS consensus 12,655m (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=8016, read 2026-10-08 10:04 JST). print_vs_bar is my estimate of H1 OP against the 6,400m plan: Q2 domestic 全店 sales came in at 97.9% against an H1 plan that needs Q2 OP of about 750m (prior-year Q2 about 380m), so H1 OP lands around 5.6-6.0bn. That is an inference from 月次, not a sourced estimate.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.48% of shares (one seller), down 0.02pt from 0.50%, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the sealed baseline). Not crowded, slightly covering. 信用倍率 12.23 (broker scrape, in the baseline), so the margin long is crowded and leveraged retail is a source of sellers on a disappointment. No options and no skew. Composite priced_lean_pct is -0.097. Tape: 769 on 2026-08-06 to 698 on 2026-10-08 (-9.2%), while the TOPIX ETF 1306.T went from 423.7 to 430.1 (+1.5%) (https://query2.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8016.T?range=2y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) domestic group sales came in at 97.9% of last year on both an existing-store and all-store basis (June 92.3, July 104.8, August 96.6 all-store; EC August 92.3). The H1 plan needs Q2 OP of about 750m against about 380m a year ago, so H1 OP and ordinary profit likely miss the 6,400m / 6,200m plan by something like 5-15%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (2026-07-09): OP +5.5% and ordinary +7.7%, but kabutan flagged ordinary progress of 90.7% against a 101.4% 3-year average, and the stock fell 2.30% (739 to 722). H1 FY26 (2025-10-02): a Q2 profit recovery plus a 10% treasury-share cancellation took it up 1.52%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 月次 are public: kabutan/minkabu reported August -3.7% as 'オンワードは冴えない' on 2026-09-04, and Q1's below-average progress rate was in kabutan's headline on 2026-07-09. If this were not priced, the stock would not have lost 9% since early August while TOPIX rose. What could still be unpriced is how much of the lower Q2 sales reaches OP, since the national promotion pause after the earthquake also cut advertising spend. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 H1 plan https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590286.pdf; kabutan Q1 progress article https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8016&b=k202607090022. Both are the plan side of the same arithmetic, not independent confirmation of the miss.

findings.finding: The release can still add a held full-year plan against a strong H2 start. September all-store sales were +4.8% and existing-store +5.2% (stores +6.7%). Onward held its full-year plan at both H1 and Q3 last year, and two direct peers held theirs at H1 prints this week: World on 10-05 (Q2 net -66%, then +1.6% the next session) and Sanyo Shokai on 10-06 (H1 loss wider than plan, +1.4% that day). That makes 'H1 miss, full-year held, September strong' the likely shape, and peers were bought on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At FY26 H1 (2025-10-02) and Q3 (2026-01-08) the full-year plan was held; the stock rose +1.52% and +1.21%. The FY27 initial guide plus a 増配 (2026-04-09) took it +4.39%.
findings.why_not_priced: Part priced: September's +5.2% got a 0.86% bounce on 10-06, but the stock has since slipped back to 698. If a held plan were priced as a relief, the name would have tracked World and Sanyo higher this week; instead it fell from 704 to 698 into the print. IFIS consensus (12,655m) sits above the company's 12,300m, so a hold is not a beat against the street. That caps this finding.
findings.independence: Onward's own September 月次 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261005/140120261005545732.pdf; Sanyo Shokai holding its plan https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8011&b=k202610060001; Onward's held plan history https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8016&b=k202601080024

findings.finding: The stock has fallen from 769 (2026-08-06) to 698 (-9.2%) while the TOPIX ETF rose 1.5%, so the Q2 weakness and the earthquake-related promotion pause have been sold ahead of the print. On a 4.7% yield and 8.5x forward P/E, a print that only confirms the visible miss is a 悪材料出尽くし setup.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-07-06 minkabu note said June's -7.6% was 'already priced' and the stock rose for four straight days. After August's -3.7%, it fell 1.51% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown itself is in the price by definition. The claim is about what a confirming print does to it. The counterweight is the crowded margin long (信用倍率 12.2): leveraged retail holders who bought for the yield or the 優待 can still sell on a headline miss. That is why this is sized small rather than as a reversal.
findings.independence: kabuyoho valuation (P/E 8.5x, yield 4.73%, PBR 1.00) https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=8016; peer World https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3612&b=n202610060671

findings.finding: Capital returns could be the surprise. The H1 print a year ago came with a cancellation of 16m treasury shares (10.13%) and the stock rose 1.52% on it. The company still holds 5.9m treasury shares (4.2%) at 31 May, trades at PBR 1.00, and has a stated payout floor of 40%. The 16-yen interim dividend is already in the plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-02, H1 results plus the cancellation: +1.52% (kabutan/minkabu attribute it partly to reduced overhang risk). 2026-04-09, 増配 to 33 yen plus guide: +4.39%.
findings.why_not_priced: No document says a buyback or cancellation is coming, so it carries no weight in the price. A repeat would be visible as a gap on the 10-09 open. It is sized as a low-probability tail, because the remaining treasury stock is partly the pool for restricted-stock compensation (disposals in June 2026).
findings.independence: Q1 短信 treasury share count https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260709590286.pdf; dividend policy https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260409/140120260409500721.pdf

findings.finding: In the 2026-07-28 Kumamoto earthquake, three Onward employees (WEGO and anySiS stores at Aeon Mall Kumamoto) died in an explosion after evacuating, and the group suspended promotion, including online, nationwide. That may bring a below-OP disaster or condolence item in H1 and a governance discussion.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed. The company held its full-year plan at H1 and Q3 last year and peers held this week, so a hold is expected. IFIS 12,655m sits above the 12,300m plan. Returns: 16-yen interim already planned; a buyback or cancellation is a tail (one happened at last year's H1). New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter: H1 OP likely 5-15% below the 6,400m plan on Q2 月次 of 97.9%. H1 ordinary of about 5.6bn would be about 45% of the full-year plan, against 50.2% last year and a 35.9% 5-year average per kabutan.

rejected_candidates.detail: The FY26 H1 release was 2025-10-02, not the estimated 10-08/10-10. The actual next-session move was +1.52% (660 to 670), so the cadence dates are off by about a week for this name.

baseline_tension: Run-up is -2.38% over 20 days, short interest is tiny and covering, and the margin long is crowded; the composite lean is about -0.1. My findings lean mildly positive against that. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held full-year plan plus a treasury-share cancellation or buyback, which I looked for and found no pre-announcement of. The negative, an H1 miss against plan, is visible in public 月次 and has already been sold for about 9% relative to TOPIX since August.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次/進捗率): finding 1 moved from -0.4 to -0.3. p_up stayed at 55 because the draft had already discounted the visible miss.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the draft was already net positive, and the strongest positives (held plan, buyback/cancellation) were searched for and recorded in baseline_tension. No change.
Nothing else changed: abs_move_pct 2.5, p_up 55, print_vs_bar -8.0 all stand.
